purpose: Teach: 四日市/東海岸/藪/鶴見/寺山/日航/本法/稲作

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、三重県四日市の公害事件の社会史研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you wrote your paper on the social history of the pollution incident in Yokkaichi, Mie Prefecture, didn't you?
lines.style: Gentle, warm curiosity. Open posture. Precise but unhurried pacing. Each phrase lands with quiet encouragement—the tone of a teacher genuinely interested in a student's work.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、米国東海岸都市の都市計画研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on urban planning research in East Coast American cities.
lines.style: Direct, slightly surprised—as if correcting a gentle misunderstanding. No defensiveness, just clarity. Steady eye contact. A student being honest about her actual work.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 藪、つまり藪医者の社会学研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you covered the sociology of folk medicine—quack doctors—in your research, is that right?
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment, almost a knowing smile in the voice. Thoughtful pause before the clarification. The tone of someone checking their own notes and finding them accurate.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、哲学者鶴見俊輔先生のご研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on the research and philosophy of the thinker Shun Tsurumi.
lines.style: Again, a quiet correction. Not correcting the teacher, but stating her actual subject. Respectful but certain. A patient student clarifying without apology.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 寺山修司の戯曲研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Then you examined the dramatic works of Shuji Terayama in your paper?
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured. A slight uplift at the end—genuine question, not assumption. Teacher-ly confidence tempered by openness to be surprised again.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、日航機墜落事故の社会記憶の研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on the social memory surrounding the Japan Airlines crash.
lines.style: Another gentle correction. Calm, factual tone. No impatience—just accurate. The voice of someone stating her work clearly for the record.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 本法、つまり当該法律の解釈研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: So your paper addressed the interpretation of that specific law?
lines.style: Softer this time—perhaps a half-smile of recognition. The rhythm slows slightly. A teacher beginning to understand the pattern and finding it endearing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、東北地方の稲作の伝統研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on the traditional rice cultivation practices of the Tohoku region.
lines.style: Final statement, clear and calm. A small sense of closure—the student has now fully articulated her actual body of work. Steady, assured, not rushed.
